description: A painting of an ornate, worn gilt-framed mirror hung on a dark wall. The mirror reflects a dim cafe interior with a cane-backed chair and a marble-topped table holding a stack of handwritten manuscript pages, a pen, a coffee cup, a red wine glass, a folded brown cloth, and an ashtray with a smoking cigarette. There is no readable text, and the scene is quiet and not graphic.
